intro: Cryptocurrency and technology sectors were the primary targets in a series of attacks linked to North Korea between April 13 and May 1, 2026. The Lazarus Group, APT37 (ScarCruft, InkySquid), and BlueNoroff were observed as the top threat actors, with the activity impacting regions including Asia, Europe, and North America. Among the nine reported incidents, eight were classified as high severity and one as critical, affecting financial services, finance, and software development globally.
